location_description: Ventura, officially named San Buenaventura (Spanish for "Saint Bonaventure"), is a city on the Central Coast of California and the county seat of Ventura County. The population was 110,763 at the 2020 census. Ventura is a popular tourist destination, owing to its historic landmarks, beaches, and resorts.
